title: Kufa Ki Shahazadi Binte Ali Hu Nana
body:
Kufa Ki Shahazadi Bintai Ali Hu Nana
Islam Tho Bacha Hai...( 2)
Mai Lut Gai Hu Nana.
1 Darbar Dekh Aye Zindan Dekh Aye (2)
Koi Our Sham Ho Tho (2)
Hazir Khadi Huu Nana.
2 Bazar Ke Safar Ne Maqtal Bula Diya Hai (2)
Apnay Watan Mai Aa Kar (2)
Mai Ajnabi Huu Nana.
3 Lay Lay Ke Nam Tera Kha e Thay Taziya Nay (2)
Jur Mai Hussainyt Mai (2)
Qaide Bani Huu Nana.
4 Har Sham Yad Aae Sham E Gariba Mujko...( 2)
Kahaimo kay Sath Mai Bhi... (2)
Jalti Rahe Hu Nana.
5 Akbar Kay qatilo Ko Mai Kaisay Bhul ja uu... (2)
Mai tai ray Qathilo Ko... (2)
Pehan chan Ti Hu Nana.
